from: June book, night 10 (Oil on Saul’s Head)
p1: Samuel walked with Saul to the edge of the city. He had a message from Heavenly Father just for Saul.
Samuel poured a little bottle of oil on Saul’s head and kissed him. The oil showed the Lord had chosen Saul to lead His people.
Many years later, Heavenly Father chose Jesus for the most important job of all. So Jesus is called Christ, the Anointed One.
p2: Samuel said, “The Spirit of the Lord will come upon you.” As Saul turned to walk away, Heavenly Father gave him “another heart.” It was like a brand-new heart, ready for his new job.
Heavenly Father can help your heart get ready too. Tonight, rest your hands over your heart and feel His love.
old: Samuel took a special bottle of oil. He poured it on Saul’s head. This meant Saul was chosen to be king! Samuel said, “Heavenly Father has anointed you to be the leader of His people.”
Later, Samuel gathered all of Israel together. He said, “Heavenly Father has chosen your king!” They drew lots, and Saul was chosen. But where was Saul? He was hiding!
They found Saul hiding among the baggage. When he stood up, he was taller than everyone else! The people shouted, “Long live the king!”
Saul started out humble and obedient. But being humble is important, even when you become important! God chose Saul because his heart was right at the beginning.
